description: Native Yggdrasil-range address derivation corpus for the LICHEN 0200::/8 profile, plus one genuine upstream Go AddrForKey reference vector kept verbatim.

profiles.upstream_go_addr_for_key: Upstream yggdrasil-go algorithm (AddrForKey): bit-invert the Ed25519 public key, count leading 1 bits into addr[1], drop the first 0 bit, then bit-pack the remainder into addr[2:16]. No hashing involved. Settled per the upstream-yggdrasil-addressing decision in spec/decisions.jsonl.

divergence_note: Post-migration (i72x.6): all derivation vectors are upstream AddrForKey byte-for-byte. The former lichen_native_sha512 profile (addr[8:16]==SHA-512 IID) is REJECTED; the iid field on each vector remains as the link-local IID only and is NOT embedded in the address.

vectors.name: lichen_sha256_empty_string_key
vectors.note: pubkey bytes are SHA-256(""); shared spot vector with yggdrasil.json

vectors.name: lichen_rfc8032_test1_key
vectors.note: public key from RFC 8032 §7.1 TEST 1 (external key provenance)

vectors.name: lichen_repeated_02_key_ul_forced_clear
vectors.note: SHA-512(pubkey)[0]=0xaa; U/L bit (0x02) must be cleared to 0xa8 in the IID

vectors.name: lichen_repeated_01_key_ul_naturally_clear
vectors.note: SHA-512(pubkey)[0]=0x5c; U/L bit already clear, IID unchanged by masking

vectors.name: lichen_deadbeef_cafebabe_key
vectors.note: binding invariant case: address[8:16] MUST equal iid

vectors.name: lichen_bit0_set_key
vectors.note: single bit set at position 0 (MSB of byte 0)

vectors.name: lichen_bit_mid_set_key
vectors.note: single bit set at position 128 (MSB of byte 16, midpoint of the key)

vectors.name: lichen_bit_last_set_key
vectors.note: single bit set at position 255 (LSB of byte 31)

vectors.name: pubkey_31_bytes_rejected
vectors.note: 31-byte key MUST raise ValueError in every implementation surface

vectors.name: pubkey_33_bytes_rejected
vectors.note: 33-byte key MUST raise ValueError in every implementation surface
